**Resubmitted — RENEWAL: deviation (fallback target), validated ok:true.**

Repair to the flagged element: the notice window is now expressed as express operative notice language conforming to the document's numeral convention — "gives the other party written notice at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term" — carrying both the words "written notice" and the figure sixty (60) days, so the ≤60-day element is stated unambiguously.

- Operation 2 unchanged: "Charges for each renewal term will not exceed 105% of the charges in effect for the immediately preceding term of the applicable Service Option Attachment."
- Two operations; minimality gate passes; Section 13.1's mid-term change right, non-retroactivity sentence and Customer's 30-day no-charge termination election retained verbatim.
- Recorded in the rationale rather than redlined: the four preferred-level gaps, the Section 13.1 baseline-reset risk (mitigated by Customer's no-charge termination election), and the escalation point if any Order Form term exceeds 12 months (automatic multi-year renewals).
